scope: Proposition 3.3 (A proper product quantizer) of the manuscript “Strong diffeomorphic approximation in three dimensions for p>2” (preprints/Strong-diffeomorphic-approximation-in-three-dimensions-for-p-gt-2-September-24-2026/main.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 368 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 824a96588feb42d5), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF pages 39-40. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. The quote crosses a page break and includes whatever the extraction places there, such as a page number. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. statement: Fix 0 < c < m with c < 1. One can choose a locally finite family of interior sites in Λ, with one contact at each ordinary site and the two protected 39 contacts at each paired site. The family can include the rectangular paired arrays constructed in Lemma 3.4. Index these site and contact pairs by i, writing them as (qi, xi), and define G(q) = sup i {F(qi) + xi · (q − qi) + c 2|q − qi|2 }, T = (∂G)−1 , (3.4) where the supremum also includes the support based at every qi / ∈ Λ. Here q is an output of T, and y ∈ ∂G(q) is an input. Then T : R3 → R3 is single-valued and c−1-Lipschitz, equals the identity outside Λ, and restricts to a proper onto map of Λ to itself, as finely close to the identity as prescribed. Inside Λ, G − c|q|2/2 is a locally finite maximum of affine functions. Its diagram has compact convex polyhedral cells. Write pi = xi − cqi. Over the relative interior of a face P, whose active indices are I(P), its exact input product is ∂G(q) = cq + conv{pi : i ∈ I(P)}, T(cq + v) = q (q ∈ relint P). (3.5) The two factors have orthogonal direction spaces of complementary dimensions. Every retained support owns a genuine three-dimensional output cell Ci. Its closed input block Xi = cCi + pi (3.6) is compactly contained in O. These closed blocks are pairwise disjoint and have locally finite, mutually disjoint protective neighborhoods within the exact regions of the carrier. Outside their union the output of T lies in the two-skeleton of the diagram.
